headline: M&B Engineering reports highest-ever quarterly and half-yearly revenue for Q2 and H1 FY27
summary: M&B Engineering Limited has released its financial performance update for the second quarter and first half of fiscal year 2027. The company announced that it achieved its highest-ever quarterly earnings and half-yearly revenue to date. The press release was officially submitted to the exchange on November 5, 2026. Retail investors tracking the engineering and infrastructure sector should note this performance milestone.
why_it_matters: Strong earnings signal robust operational execution for the company.

headline: M&B Engineering publishes investor presentation
hook: M&B Engineering releases latest investor presentation
summary: M & B Engineering Limited has filed its latest investor presentation with the National Stock Exchange. The document provides updated details on the company's operational performance and strategic outlook. Retail investors can review these materials on the exchange website to assess the company's current financial position and future growth plans.
why_it_matters: Provides updated operational data for existing shareholders to evaluate.

headline: M & B Engineering releases financial results for Q2 FY27
hook: M & B Engineering reports September quarter results
summary: M & B Engineering Limited has officially filed its financial results for the period ending September 30, 2026. The company submitted these documents to the NSE as part of its mandatory quarterly reporting obligations. Retail investors can access the detailed balance sheet and profit-loss statements through the exchange portal to assess the company's recent operational performance.
why_it_matters: Quarterly performance data helps assess the company's current financial health.

headline: M & B Engineering starts commercial production at Sanand facility
hook: New plant adds capacity at Sanand
summary: M & B Engineering Limited has announced the commencement of commercial production under Phase-I of its brownfield PEB manufacturing facility in Sanand, Gujarat. The operations began on October 26, 2026. This capacity expansion allows the company to scale up its pre-engineered building manufacturing capabilities. Retail investors should note this operational milestone as it marks the beginning of revenue generation from the new plant.
whats_next: Phase-II updates from the Sanand facility
why_it_matters: New manufacturing capacity could boost revenue and earnings.
